# Demo data (synthetic)

**Everything in `extract/` and `strava-profile.json` is FAKE.** The CSVs describe an invented person, generated by
`scripts/make-demo-data.mjs` from a seeded random generator. They are not anyone's health
data. Every row carries a `Demo …` source tag (`Demo Watch`, `Demo Scale`, `Demo Strava`, …).
`extract/workout-zones.csv` (per-workout HR zones) is derived from the `Demo Strava` rows of
`workouts.csv` with its own seeded generator (each session starts at 18:00 local, so it has a
window), and `extract/hr-hourly.csv` (Watch heart rate per clock hour, the last four weeks) leaves
those windows out of its histogram, like the Shortcut sync; together they calibrate the day strain dial
(daytime heart rate 58–70 bpm, so the stress estimate and the energy bank show ordinary days).
`strava-profile.json` is a hand-written, invented Strava athlete snapshot (name, gear, devices) that
feeds the example page's profile sheet in place of the gitignored `data/profile/strava-profile.json`.
`extract/journal-daily.csv` is an invented behaviour journal (its own seeded generator: drinks mostly
at weekends, mobility on rest days…) for the example's My journal card and behaviour insights; any
association with the demo recovery is chance.
`extract/foodlog-daily.csv` is an invented food log in the sync's format (`data/nutrition/sync-foodlog.js`;
its own seeded generator around the example plan's maintain targets, a few days with a dinner or a
macro missing) for the example's nutrition score; the personal build reads `data/nutrition/` instead.

## Why it exists

`npm run build:example` (`DATA_MODE=example`) reads this folder in place of your real,
gitignored `data/apple-health/extract/`. That way the example page shows every section
(Inicio dials, Salud, Entrenos, intake rings) on a fresh clone, before you drop your own
export.

## Regenerate

```bash
node scripts/make-demo-data.mjs                     # fixed defaults: identical bytes every run
node scripts/make-demo-data.mjs --end 2026-12-31    # move the window (the files change)
```

The window ends on a fixed date, so the example page reads as stale (dimmed dials, no intake
rings) a few days after that date. That is the page's normal staleness handling, not a bug.
The test `scripts/make-demo-data.test.mjs` fails if these files drift from the generator.

## Rules

- Never put real measurements here: this folder is tracked and public.
- Your own data goes in `data/apple-health/` (gitignored), never in `data/demo/`.
